frontier.hypothesis: The seat-level RA read is now the live axis, and it is tractable: the 15-line residual is a small, nameable set of seats that a fresh global.c/local-alloc trace can localise exactly as s3 did for the 30-line residual.
frontier.mechanism: global.c allocates allocnos in a fixed priority order and each assignment ORs its hard reg into the conflicts of every conflicting allocno, so the whole seat map shifts when the first-allocated allocno changes. s4's two winning edits sit directly on the region that produced ord=0, so the s1-s3 ids (129 = div16, 122 = abs_val, 86 = the table entry) are stale by construction.

frontier.hypothesis: The one spelling family still unmeasured on this body is ADDRESS-COMPUTATION SPLITTING at sites other than the table entry - i.e. exactly what varL is, applied where an address is computed and then dereferenced.
frontier.mechanism: s5 proved naming plain values is byte-neutral here while varL (ent = &row[a1]; a2 = *ent;) was worth 7 points, so the reachable lever is the split of address arithmetic away from its load, not naming as such. That narrows the search space from 'a dozen sites' to the handful with that shape.
frontier.next_probe: Enumerate ONLY the sites where an address is computed and then dereferenced. The sweep already covered the pointer-intermediate spelling of the two &Judge indexed reads and of the OUTER (&D_800A310C)[...] index and found them neutral, so the remaining untested shape is splitting the INNER index load alone (u8 *ip = &D_8008DA08; s32 idx = ip[*(s16 *)(arg0 + 0xA)];) with the outer load left inline, and the symmetric split of `row = new_var + (a0 * 3)` into a separately-named scaled offset. Measure each SINGLY on top of the 15-floor body at 159/159; s4 proved these levers contend rather than compose, so never stack without per-delta measurement.

frontier.hypothesis: A further permuter reseed is worth running only if it is seeded from a chassis that differs in CONTROL FLOW, not in naming or pointer spelling.
frontier.mechanism: Five independent naming/pointer-spelling measurements are now neutral-or-worse and two naming-adjacent chassis basins are exhausted at ~17k iterations each, so the random walk keeps re-entering the same preference neighbourhood. A control-flow-shaped chassis (mixed goto/return exit forms in the kind-dispatch, or the D_800A38BA guard restructured as an early-out) moves the basic-block boundaries and therefore the live ranges themselves rather than the copy structure.
